tools.name: determine_point_group
tools.description: Determine the point group symmetry of a molecule given its molecular formula or SMILES.

molecule.description: Molecule identifier: SMILES string, molecular formula, or common name (e.g., 'H2O', 'CCO', 'benzene', 'CH4').

tools.name: query_coordination_geometry
tools.description: Query and predict coordination geometry for complexes based on coordination number, metal center, ligands, and VSEPR/CFSE considerations.

coordination_number.description: Coordination number (CN) of the complex, e.g., 2, 4, 5, 6.

metal_ion.description: Metal ion symbol (e.g., 'Fe2+', 'Cu2+', 'Co3+'). Optional but improves accuracy.

ligand_type.description: Ligand type or description (e.g., 'strong field', 'weak field', 'bidentate', 'Cl-', 'NH3'). Optional.

tools.name: balance_equation
tools.description: Balance chemical equations for ordinary reactions using algebraic matrix method.

equation.description: Unbalanced chemical equation string, e.g., 'H2+O2=H2O', 'Fe+O2=Fe2O3', 'C6H12O6+O2=CO2+H2O'. Use '=' or '→' as separator.

tools.name: balance_redox
tools.description: Balance redox reaction equations using the half-reaction method (ion-electron method). Supports acidic and basic media.

equation.description: Unbalanced redox equation string, e.g., 'MnO4- + Fe2+ + H+ = Mn2+ + Fe3+ + H2O'.

tools.name: identify_reaction_type
tools.description: Identify the type(s) of a chemical reaction from its equation string.

equation.description: Chemical equation string (balanced or unbalanced), e.g., 'MnO4- + 5Fe2+ + 8H+ = Mn2+ + 5Fe3+ + 4H2O' or 'H2+O2=H2O'.

tools.name: predict_products
tools.description: Predict the products of a chemical reaction given the reactants and optional conditions.

reactants.description: Reactant species separated by '+', e.g., 'NaCl + AgNO3' or 'CH4 + O2' or 'Zn + H2SO4'.

tools.name: get_standard_potential
tools.description: Query standard electrode potential (E°) for a given redox half-reaction or couple.

query.description: Half-reaction query: species name, formula, or redox couple (e.g., 'Cu2+/Cu', 'Fe3+/Fe2+', 'MnO4-/Mn2+', 'Zn2+/Zn', 'O2/H2O').

as_oxidation.description: If True, return oxidation potential (E°ox = -E°red). Default returns reduction potential.

tools.name: calculate_cell_potential
tools.description: Calculate the standard or non-standard cell potential (EMF) of a galvanic/voltaic cell given cathode and anode half-reactions.

cathode.description: Cathode half-reaction (reduction): species name or E° value in V (e.g., 'Cu2+/Cu', '0.34').

anode.description: Anode half-reaction (oxidation): species name or E° value in V (e.g., 'Zn2+/Zn', '-0.76').

n.description: Number of electrons transferred in the balanced overall reaction.

tools.name: nernst_equation
tools.description: Calculate non-standard cell/electrode potential using the Nernst equation. Supports both code (numeric parameters) and text (string) interfaces.

E0.description: Standard electrode potential E° in Volts.

n.description: Number of electrons transferred in the half-reaction or overall reaction.

tools.name: identify_oxidizing_agent
tools.description: Identify the oxidizing agent and reducing agent in a redox reaction, including oxidation state changes and electron transfer details.

equation.description: Chemical equation string (balanced or unbalanced), e.g., 'MnO4- + 5Fe2+ + 8H+ = Mn2+ + 5Fe3+ + 4H2O' or 'H2 + CuO = Cu + H2O' or 'Cl2 + 2NaI = 2NaCl + I2'.
